ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var destination = attributes.queryParams.destination var whereClause = if (destination != null) "WHERE toAirport = '$(destination)'" else "" --- "SELECT * FROM american $(whereClause)"

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (flight) -> { ID:flight.ID, code: (flight.code1 default "") ++ (flight.code2 default ""), price:flight.price default 0, departureDate:flight.takeOffDate as Date as String {format: "yyyy/MM/dd"} default "", origin:flight.fromAirport default "", destination:flight.toAirport default "", emptySeats:flight.seatsAvailable default 0, plane: { "type":flight.planeType default "", totalSeats:flight.totalSeats default 0 } }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { ID: payload[0].ID, code: (payload[0].code1 default "") ++ (payload[0].code2 default ""), price: payload[0].price default 0, departureDate: payload[0].takeOffDate as Date as String {format: "yyyy/MM/dd"} default "", origin: payload[0].fromAirport default "", destination: payload[0].toAirport default "", emptySeats: payload[0].seatsAvailable default 0, plane: { "type": payload[0].planeType default "", totalSeats: payload[0].totalSeats default 0 } }
